description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day adventure in Bali, Denpasar, for two. This itinerary focuses on exciting outdoor activities, from ziplining and bike tours to snorkeling and mountain hikes, ensuring an unforgettable experience.

accommodation.amenities: wifi, beach access, pool, airport shuttle, rooftop terrace

days.title: Arrival and Relaxation
days.description: Arrive in Denpasar, check into your hotel, and enjoy a relaxing afternoon by the pool or beach to unwind after your journey.

days.title: Zipline and Ropes Adventure
days.description: Kick off your adventure with an exhilarating zipline and ropes course experience in Denpasar.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see lush landscapes and challenging aerial obstacles.What to bring: Wear comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes.What to eat: Pack snacks and water to stay energized throughout the activity.Good to know: This activity is perfect for adventure seekers looking for a thrill.

days.title: Snorkelling Day Trip
days.description: Explore the vibrant underwater world of Bali with a snorkelling day trip.

activities.activity_name: Snorkelling Day Trip from Denpasar — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see colorful coral reefs and diverse marine life.What to bring: Bring your swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, and a hat.What to eat: Lunch is often provided on day trips, but confirm with the tour operator.Good to know: This trip is suitable for families and adventure seekers alike.

days.title: Denpasar Bike Tour
days.description: Discover the scenic beauty of Denpasar on an invigorating bike tour.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see local villages, rice paddies, and beautiful landscapes.What to bring: Wear comfortable clothes, closed-toe shoes, and bring water.What to eat: Enjoy local snacks or a light meal at a stop along the route.Good to know: This tour is great for active travellers and families.

days.title: Mountain Hike and Viewpoints
days.description: Challenge yourselves with a mountain hike to enjoy panoramic views of Denpasar.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see stunning natural scenery and breathtaking viewpoints.What to bring: Wear sturdy hiking shoes, bring water, snacks, and sun protection.What to eat: Consider packing a light lunch to enjoy at a scenic spot.Good to know: This activity is best suited for active travellers.

days.title: Cultural Immersion and Sunset Cruise
days.description: Immerse yourselves in Balinese culture with a museum visit, followed by a relaxing sunset cruise.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll see local art, historical artifacts, and cultural exhibits.What to bring: Bring a camera and comfortable walking shoes.What to eat: Enjoy a meal at a local restaurant near the museum.Good to know: This pass offers access to various cultural sites.

What you'll see: You'll see a beautiful sunset over the ocean and the coastline.What to bring: Bring a light jacket, camera, and enjoy the sea breeze.What to eat: Some cruises offer light snacks or drinks, check details upon booking.Good to know: This is a romantic and relaxing activity for couples and families.

days.title: Departure Preparation
days.description: Enjoy a final Balinese breakfast, do some last-minute souvenir shopping, and prepare for your departure.

warnings: Budget total corrected from 0.00 AUD to 6116.00 AUD.
